Please add more details, is the res folder empty? Does it happen every time or only with specific files?

It could be related to:
* https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/114629

> Please add more details, is the res folder empty? Does it happen every time or only with specific files?
> 
> It could be related to:
> 
>     * [Shortcut for Open in Terminal crashes Editor while FileSystem has Favorites selected #114629](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/114629)

Hello! Let me add more info:

It happens both in a project that has files and in a new empty project (it only has the icon.svg). I tested it on the res folder, but I can confirm that it happens when doing it on any file.

I also deleted every file of the new project and I get the same error when trying to open the red folder in the terminal.

The option of opening it in the file manager works just fine. I am also using the default terminal that comes with Fedora (it's a clean install with only Godot and the latests updates).
Let me know if you need anything in specific, and thank you

Does it happen in [4.6.rc2](https://godotengine.org/article/release-candidate-godot-4-6-rc-2/)? I can't replicate this myself so it could be Linux specific, but if it is related to the bug above it shouldn't happen in rc2
